newsitem.title: INDIA: India clears 8.75 bln rupee GE Capital project.
newsitem.headline: India clears 8.75 bln rupee GE Capital project.

text.p: India on Friday approved a foreign direct investment project of GE Capital Services India Ltd worth 8.75 billion rupees for providing financial services, a government statement said.
The government cleared 84 projects involving foreign direct investment (FDI) worth 26.74 billion rupees.
It approved a proposal by electricity generator CESC Ltd to raise $80 million through foreign commercial borrowings.
A proposal by News Television India Private Ltd, an affiliate of Rupert Murdoch's News Corp, involving an investment of 400 million rupees was also given the green signal.
Another proposal by UBS Securities of Switzerland of 175 million rupees for providing non-banking financial services was also approved.

The government cleared the proposal by Allied Signal India Pvt Ltd, an affiliate of U.S. Allied Signals, to promote research and development in aerospace, automotive products, chemical fibres, advanced material and related industry.
